name: verify-ai-clone
description: Exact clone of the Verify AI results-verification app (React + Vite client, Node/Express server)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c green,cyan "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:api
scripts.test:api: node server/test-auth.mjs && node server/test-verify.mjs && node server/test-hardening.mjs
